title: Numerical Methods for Dynamical Low-Rank Approximations of Stochastic Differential Equations -- Part I: Time discretization
summary: In this work (Part I), we study three time-discretization schemes for the Dynamical Low-Rank Approximation (DLRA) of high-dimensional stochastic differential equations (SDEs). Specifically, we consider the Dynamically Orthogonal (DO) method for DLRA proposed and analyzed in arXiv:2308.11581v4, which approximates the true solution by a linear combination of few products between deterministic orthonormal modes and stochastic modes, both time-dependent.
